name: larger_thermal_force_drift
hypothesis: Doubling the previously tolerated thermal drift may exceed the insertion controller's bias compensation. Sustained residual force can satisfy the filtered touchdown threshold before the plate reaches its supports.
expected_failure: Step 6 releases prematurely and fails the seating check, leaving the plate unsupported or leaning outside its intended slot.
real_world_story: The wrist force sensor warms during a long loading cycle after being tared cold.
